# Module notes

<!-- provenance -->
> **AI-written interpretation** of the code at commit `1a80fc8`, based on the extracted facts (`integrations.md`, `change-impact.md`, `architecture.md`, `data-model.md`, `graph.json`) and sampled source. Verify details against the code.


One sentence on what each busy folder, and each file to be careful with, is for. Written from names only (paths, function and class names), not from reading the code.

## Folders

- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/app`: Manages documents, sessions, and context for the CAD viewer app.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor`: Contains the main editor entry file.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/command`: Handles command execution and management in the editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/global`: Manages global UI themes and layouts for the editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/input/ui`: Handles input management and UI interactions for the editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/view`: Manages view modes and selections in the editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/i18n`: Handles internationalization and localization messages.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/service`: Manages entity and layer services for CAD operations.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/ui`: Contains UI components and dialogs for the viewer.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/util`: Provides utility functions for CAD operations and formatting.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/view`: Handles entity display and layout in the viewer.
- `packages/vite-config`: Configures Vite for building and outputting the library.

## Files to be careful with

- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/ui/AcUiFullscreenPanel.ts`: Manages the fullscreen panel UI component.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/command/draw/AcApSplineCmd.ts`: Executes and manages spline drawing commands.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/view/AcTrLayout.ts`: Handles entity preview and layer management in the layout view.
- `packages/cad-svg-plugin/src/AcSvgEntity.ts`: Manages SVG entity operations and transformations.
- `packages/pdf-renderer/src/renderer/AcPdfEntity.ts`: Handles PDF entity rendering and transformation operations.
